english_json: "It is truly meet and just, right and profitable to salvation to praise thee, O Lord! at all times, but chiefly and more gloriously on this night, when Christ our Paschal Lamb was sacrificed. For he is the true Lamb, that hath taken away the sins of the world. Who, by dying, destroyed our death, and by rising again, restored our life. And therefore with the angels and archangels, with the thrones and dominations, and with all the troops of the celestial army, we sing the hymn of thy glory, incessantly saying:"

"Partaking of the same communion, and celebrating the most sacred night of the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ according to the flesh; and also honoring the memory, in the first place, of the glorious ever Virgin Mary, mother of the same God and our Lord Jesus Christ,"
"℣. Go, Mass is ended, alleluia, alleluia.\n℟. Thanks be to God, alleluia, alleluia."
